description: Unity Catalog External Location with access_point field — FSx for ONTAP S3 AP access test

environment.workspace_type: Customer-managed VPC (same VPC as FSx for ONTAP)

external_location_config.name: fsxn_lakehouse_location
external_location_config.note: access_point field added per Databricks support recommendation

uc_external_location_dbutils_fs_ls.interpretation: Unity Catalog External Location with access_point field successfully lists FSx for ONTAP S3 AP contents. The session policy now includes the S3 AP ARN, allowing UC-governed access.

boto3_instance_profile.error: AccessDenied: Could not access through this access point
boto3_instance_profile.interpretation: Instance Profile IAM policy (databricks-fsxn-access-profile) does not have the correct S3 AP permissions. This is an IAM policy issue, not a platform boundary. The UC path works because the Storage Credential role has broader permissions.

conclusion.key_finding: Setting the access_point field on the External Location resolves the session policy issue. Unity Catalog can now govern access to FSx for ONTAP S3 Access Points.
requirements: Customer-managed VPC workspace (same VPC as FSx for ONTAP)
External Location with access_point field set to the S3 AP ARN
Storage Credential IAM role with s3:ListBucket and s3:GetObject on the S3 AP ARN
NAT Gateway for Databricks cluster to reach control plane
conclusion.governance_model: Full Unity Catalog governance (lineage, fine-grained access control, audit)
conclusion.article_impact: This changes the article conclusion from 'UC blocked' to 'UC works with access_point field configuration'
